description: Generate an HTML or JSON audit report from SBOM data, optionally enriched with vulnerability scan results. Suitable for PCI-DSS and compliance audits.

directory_path.description: Path to project root (generates fresh SBOM)

include_vulnerabilities.description: Include vulnerability scan in report (default: true)

output_path.description: Path to write report file. Absent = no write.

name: sbom_export_report
